mobility.rule: mobility hardware is temporary and external; remove skates before play so all playing load remains on the four classic pinball legs/levelers

leg_corners.architecture: classic compact steel internal corner brackets with through-bolted leg hardware
leg_corners.exact_leg_hole_pattern: BLOCKED until actual classic leg/bracket set is selected and measured
leg_corners.fallback: add compact local plywood backing only if physical bracket/bolt proof test shows unacceptable bearing/crush or joint movement
leg_corners.rule: do not consume large cabinet interior volumes with 18+18 mm corner blocks unless testing proves they are necessary

pc_service.architecture: internal lift-out service sled accessed from above with playfield raised; no forward/front drawer travel
pc_service.retention: four captive M6 or quarter-turn retainers on replaceable locator blocks; exact hardware TBD
pc_service.rule: normal PC service occurs from the open playfield; the sled lifts vertically and can be fully removed without opening/cutting the cabinet front

reference_photo_takeaways: keep the cabinet center visually and physically open rather than filling it with bulky fixed furniture
mount service electronics on removable boards/rails and localized wall brackets
reserve clear service aisles and cable routing instead of permanent broad shelves
keep PC, power and controller hardware removable from above
preserve SSF sidewall zones and future DOF mounting space
